basic_info.description: Welcome to 171 Rey Street, a beautifully renovated 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom home nestled in San Francisco’s vibrant Visitacion Valley neighborhood. Thoughtfully updated with contemporary finishes, this residence seamlessly blends style and functionality, featuring a gorgeous kitchen designed for the modern chef with sleek cabinetry, premium countertops, and high-end appliances.  The inviting layout offers abundant natural light throughout, enhancing the warmth and charm of each room. Retreat into spacious bedrooms, accompanying by tastefully updated bathrooms, offering comfort and privacy for family and guests alike.  Step outside to discover a private retreat perfect for hosting summer barbecues, gardening, or simply unwinding with friends beneath the Bay Area sun. Ideally located near picturesque hiking trails, a popular public golf course, and the scenic San Francisco Bay, outdoor enthusiasts will feel right at home. Commuting is effortless with quick access to nearby Caltrain station and major transportation routes.  171 Rey Street truly captures the best of city living and serene neighborhood charm
